description: Ephemeral notification with a tone-coloured side bar and one optional action.

tone.description: The side bar's colour: neutral reports no outcome, success and danger report one. Whether the toast announces assertively.

actionLabel.description: The label of the single inline action: Undo, Retry, View logs. Absent renders no action.

persist.description: Disables the host's auto-dismiss and shows the Pinned marker. **Implied by `tone: "danger"`, which ignores `false`**: a critical message that vanishes on a timer is one a user can miss entirely, so an error state makes the pin mandatory and the layers enforce it rather than leave it to documentation. Set it explicitly for any other tone that must not disappear on its own.

dismissible.description: Whether the × is shown. Every layer gates the × on this member and never on whether anything listens for `close`, because Arena never derives what it draws from what a consumer listens for.
